title: CONNECT-UDP Conversion Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9298 conversion policy.
scope: This verification covers non-multiplexed stream references as whole-connection references, RFC 9298 Section 5 Context ID zero HTTP Datagram format, UDP packet to HTTP Datagram conversion, HTTP Datagram to UDP packet conversion, non-zero Context ID rejection for UDP packet conversion, and tunnel-closed conversion rejection.
preconditions: RFC 9298 datagram, tunnel setup, and socket lifecycle policy helpers are trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused conversion policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 conversion artifacts, generated triage reflects RFC 9298 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The remaining RFC 9298 conversion policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
